title: 第550章 上门寻仇第549章 突发情况
content_zh:
听到众人鼓励的话，这位闯进来的弟子伸手擦了擦额头上的汗水，深呼吸一口气说道：“宗主大人！有人跑到我们山门前叫嚣说，我们乾元剑宗惧怕他们明月山庄实力，不敢邀请他们参加剑道交流会！”
“啪～”弟子的话刚说完，吴天昊手中的杯子便被他摔在地上，他直接从木凳上起身喝道：“放他娘的狗屁！是他们明月山庄坏了我的规矩，我才将他们踢出此次剑道交流会的，哪来的惧怕他明月山庄一说？蔡明宇这个老小子是不是想跟我过不去？”
乾元剑宗弟子闻言没再多说什么，而是不动声色的离开了，而吴天昊则是对着众人拱手说道：“抱歉！打扰各位雅兴了，我先离开一会儿稍后就回来！”
“带上我们呀吴老弟！我倒要看看他明月山庄到底有什么理由来打扰我们的雅兴！”陈老一个闪身来到吴天昊身侧，伸手抓住他的肩膀。
众人闻言也立刻附和说要跟他一起去看看，看着出言的人这么多吴天昊知道拒绝不了，便再次抱拳说道：“那就劳烦诸位跟我去看看了！”
“哗啦啦～”除了杨修三人，其他人都起身了，杨修也不好意思留在这里继续吃饭，也跟着人群向外走去。
乾元剑宗秘境入口处，一群身穿藏青色长袍胸口绣着银白色月牙的人将乾元剑宗秘境入口围住，为首的一个中年人开口说道：“我也不想为难你们，但是不仅我亲儿子在你们这里被砍了一根手指，还将我们明月山庄踢出此次剑道交流会，终归要给我们一个解释吧！”
中年人话落一步踏出，一股气势从他体内蔓延出来，两名弟子瞬间被压制在地上没办法起身，中年人笑了笑便向着入口走去，但他带着人刚走了几步，一个人从乾元剑宗秘境内走了出来，这人不是别人正是乾元剑宗的雷长老雷火言。
“明宇老兄！这只是我们乾元剑宗普通弟子，你对他们出手也不怕失了九品高手的气度？”雷火言笑着开口，他话说完气势爆发而出，随着他气势的爆发，两名弟子顿时感觉身上一轻，下一秒两人从地上爬了起来，对着雷火言行礼说道：“感谢雷长老出手！”
雷火言没有看两人，反倒是摆摆手表示这些小事情：“你们两个先进去吧，这里的事情我来处理！”
“是！长老！”
“是！雷长老！”
两名弟子说完话便抬脚迈入乾元剑宗秘境内，蔡明宇没有任何阻拦，而是摆摆手说道：“你们都退后，我要会会这个九品之下第一人，看看他的实力是不是和名头一样强！”
众人听到蔡明宇的话立刻退后，给两人空出一个空地，等众人停步蔡明宇才对着雷火言说道：“别愣着了，把你的武器拿出来吧！让我看看你的实力！”
雷火言二话没说将剑从身后拿了出来，他双手握剑死死盯着蔡明宇，蔡明宇没拿武器只是嚣张的对着雷火言摆摆手说道：“来吧！向我挥剑！”
虽然蔡明宇态度很嚣张，但脾气不好的雷火言并没有生气，反倒是用最强的一击向着蔡明宇进攻而去。
“这就是你的奔雷刺？来的好！有九品的水准了！”蔡明宇夸赞一句，随后他也快步向着雷火言冲去。
“父亲他真的没问题吗？就这么冲回去，对方可是拿着长剑的！”蔡清有些担忧的看着蔡明宇，站在他身旁的家仆闻言立刻开口说道：“少爷您放心吧！老爷可是九品中期实力，就算不拿武器击败一个八品也没有任何问题！”
“你的速度太慢了！”蔡明宇高喊一声，下一秒他改变方向躲过雷火言正面一击，绕到他的右侧一脚向着雷火言的腹部踢出，雷火言见状没有任何惊慌，反倒是嘴角露出一个笑容，下一秒他手腕用力向前刺的一击硬生生变成一个横斩，突然的变招让蔡明宇完全没想到。
“砰～”雷火言的长剑劈砍在蔡明宇腿上发出沉闷的响声，雷火言见状立刻后退，他知道自己的实力和对方还是有不小差距的，如果继续攻击很可能会被他击伤。

蔡明宇看着雷火言撤退的如此干脆，眼神突然间黯淡了一些，因为他确实做了雷火言再出手的准备。
“力道不错！”蔡明宇弯腰整理了一下衣服，他的裤腿已经被雷火言长剑斩出一道口子，雷火言透过口子看到了里面明晃晃的铁板！
“怪不得不躲，原来用剑的蔡庄主还做了两手准备嘛！”雷火言语气带着嘲讽的开口。
“你懂什么？我父亲这叫谨慎！”蔡明宇还没有开口，蔡清先一步开口喊道。
蔡明宇闻言回头看了蔡清一眼，让雷火言没想到的是仅仅是这么轻飘飘的一眼，蔡清便“扑通”一声，直接跪在了地上，左右开弓打起了脸。
“十”
“九”
“八”
“……”
“二”
“一”
蔡明宇倒数十个数后，蔡清才停止，他的脸已经完全红肿了，蔡明宇摆摆手说道：“没有足够的实力就不要在强者战斗的时候插嘴！”
“我知道了父亲！”蔡清低着头身体能明显的看到颤抖。
“废物！”蔡明宇冷哼一声，再次转头看向雷火言说道，“我承认小看你了，你有资格让我拿出我的武器！”
蔡明宇一伸手，一把剑从他身后扔向他，他没回头一把抓住剑柄，直接向着雷火言刺去。
在雷火言的感知下，面前的蔡明宇如同一只猛虎向自己冲来，而在他面前自己是一只瘸腿的兔子，完全不知道要怎么抵挡他的进攻。
就在雷火言思考的时候，一个身影出现在他面前，因为距离较近的原因，他能清晰的闻到对方身上的饭菜香和酒香，而这个人的侧脸他很熟悉正是乾元剑宗当代宗主吴天昊。
“乾元！”吴天昊大喝一声，一剑斩出将刺来的进攻逼退，蔡明宇退了三步止住脚步，口中带着嘲讽的说道：“你终于可能出来了，怎么不在里面躲着了？”
“躲？对付你我还用躲？不要太好笑！”吴天昊也不客气直接回怼道。
content_en:
Hearing everyone's words of encouragement, the disciple who broke in reached out and wiped the sweat from his forehead, took a deep breath and said, "Master! Someone ran to our mountain gate and shouted that our Qianyuan Sword Sect is afraid of their Mingyue Villa's strength and does not dare to invite them to participate in the sword exchange meeting!"
"Pa~" As soon as the disciple finished speaking, Wu Tianhao threw the cup in his hand to the ground. He stood up from the wooden stool and shouted: "What the hell! It was their Mingyue Villa who broke my rules, so I kicked them out of this kendo exchange meeting. How can I be afraid of what Mingyue Villa will say? Does this old boy Cai Mingyu want to get in trouble with me?"
The disciples of the Qianyuan Sword Sect didn't say anything more after hearing this, but left quietly, while Wu Tianhao raised his hands to everyone and said, "Sorry! I'm disturbing everyone, I'll leave for a while and come back later!"
"Brother Wu, take us with you! I want to see what reason he has in Mingyue Villa to disturb our enjoyment!" Mr. Chen ducked to Wu Tianhao's side and reached out to grab his shoulder.
After hearing this, everyone immediately agreed and said that they wanted to go with him to see it. Seeing so many people speaking out, Wu Tianhao knew that he could not refuse, so he clasped his fists again and said, "Then please follow me and go see it!"
"Wow~" Everyone except Yang Xiu and the other three stood up. Yang Xiu was too embarrassed to stay here and continue eating, so he followed the crowd and walked out.
At the entrance of the Qianyuan Sword Sect's secret realm, a group of people wearing navy blue robes with silver-white crescents embroidered on their chests surrounded the entrance of the Qianyuan Sword Sect's secret realm. A middle-aged man in the lead said, "I don't want to embarrass you, but not only did my own son cut off a finger here, but also kicked our Mingyue Villa out of this kendo exchange meeting. You must give us an explanation after all!"
After the middle-aged man finished speaking, he took a step forward, and an aura spread out from his body. The two disciples were instantly suppressed on the ground and unable to get up. The middle-aged man smiled and walked towards the entrance, but he took the people just a few steps, and a person walked out from the Qianyuan Sword Sect's secret territory. This person was none other than Lei Huoyan, the elder Lei of the Qianyuan Sword Sect.
"Brother Mingyu! These are just ordinary disciples of our Qianyuan Sword Sect. Are you afraid of losing the magnanimity of a ninth-grade master if you attack them?" Lei Huoyan said with a smile. After he spoke, his aura burst out. As his aura exploded, the two disciples suddenly felt light on their bodies. The next second they got up from the ground, saluted Lei Huoyan and said, "Thank you, Elder Lei, for taking action!"
Lei Huoyan didn't look at the two of them. Instead, he waved his hands to express these small matters: "You two go in first, I will handle the things here!"
"Yes! Elder!"
"Yes! Elder Lei!"
After the two disciples finished speaking, they stepped into the secret territory of the Qianyuan Sword Sect. Cai Mingyu did not stop him in any way, but waved his hand and said, "You all stand back. I want to meet this person who is the number one under the ninth rank and see if his strength is as strong as his name!"
After everyone heard Cai Mingyu's words, they immediately stepped back, leaving a space for the two of them. When everyone stopped, Cai Mingyu said to Lei Huoyan: "Stop being stunned, take out your weapons! Let me see your strength!"
Lei Huoyan took out the sword from behind without saying a word. He held the sword in both hands and stared at Cai Mingyu. Cai Mingyu didn't hold a weapon but just waved his hand to Lei Huoyan arrogantly and said, "Come on! Swing the sword at me!"
Although Cai Mingyu had an arrogant attitude, Lei Huoyan, who had a bad temper, was not angry. Instead, he attacked Cai Mingyu with the strongest blow.
"Is this your Thunder Thorn? Well done! It's at the ninth level!" Cai Mingyu praised, and then he quickly rushed towards Lei Huoyan.
"Father, is he really okay? He just rushed back, and the other party was holding a long sword!" Cai Qing looked at Cai Mingyu with some worry. The servant standing beside him heard this and immediately said: "Young MasterDon’t worry, Lord! The master is a mid-level ninth-level player, so even if he doesn’t use a weapon, he can defeat an eighth-level player without any problem! "
"You're too slow! "Cai Mingyu shouted, and the next second he changed direction to avoid Lei Huoyan's frontal blow, went around to his right and kicked Lei Huoyan in the abdomen. Lei Huoyan did not panic when he saw this, but instead showed a smile on his lips. The next second he stabbed forward with his wrist and turned into a horizontal slash. The sudden change of moves completely surprised Cai Mingyu.
"Bang~" Lei Huoyan's long sword struck Cai Mingyu's leg with a dull sound. Upon seeing this, Lei Huoyan immediately retreated. He knew that there was still a big gap between his own strength and his opponent. If he continued to attack, he would probably be injured by him.
Cai Mingyu's eyes suddenly dimmed when he saw Lei Huoyan retreating so simply, because he was indeed prepared for Lei Huoyan to take action again.
“Good strength! "Cai Mingyu bent down and straightened his clothes. His trouser legs had been slashed with Lei Huoyan's sword. Through the opening, Lei Huoyan saw the shining iron plate inside!
"It's strange that I had to hide. It turns out that Master Cai, who used the sword, had made two preparations! "Lei Huoyan spoke with a mocking tone.
"What do you know? My father calls this caution! "Before Cai Mingyu opened his mouth, Cai Qing shouted first.
After hearing this, Cai Mingyu turned around and glanced at Cai Qing. What Lei Huoyan didn't expect was that it was just such a light glance. Cai Qing immediately knelt on the ground with a "plop" and slapped his face with his bow from left to right.
"ten"
"nine"
"eight"
"..."
"two"
"one"
After Cai Mingyu counted down, Cai Qing stopped. His face was completely red and swollen. Cai Mingyu waved his hand and said, "If you don't have enough strength, don't interrupt when the strong ones are fighting! "
"I know father! "Cai Qing lowered his head and could clearly see the trembling in his body.
"Trash! Cai Mingyu snorted coldly, turned to look at Lei Huoyan again and said, "I admit that I underestimated you. You are qualified to ask me to take out my weapon!" "
Cai Mingyu stretched out his hand and a sword was thrown at him from behind. Without looking back, he grabbed the hilt of the sword and stabbed Lei Huoyan directly.
Under Lei Huoyan's perception, Cai Mingyu in front of him was like a tiger charging toward him, but in front of him, he was a lame rabbit, not knowing how to resist his attack.
Just when Lei Huoyan was thinking, a figure appeared in front of him. Because of the close distance, he could clearly smell the aroma of food and wine on the other person. The profile of this person was very familiar to him and it was Wu Tianhao, the contemporary leader of the Qianyuan Sword Sect.
"Qianyuan! "Wu Tianhao shouted loudly and slashed out with his sword to push back the attack. Cai Mingyu took three steps back and stopped, saying with a mocking tone in his mouth: "You may have finally come out, why aren't you hiding inside? "
"Hide? Do I need to hide to deal with you? Don't be too funny! "Wu Tianhao replied directly without being polite.
